title: GetThreadResponse
description:
Successful response from a `getThread` request.

The `comment` property is deprecated.
For details of a comment thread, please use the `thread` property.

AddSuggestedEdit.description: A suggestion to add some text.

Comment.description:
The comment object, which contains metadata about the comment.
Deprecated in favor of the new `thread` object.

CommentContent.description: The content of a comment thread or reply.

plaintext.description:
The content in plaintext.
Any user mention tags are shown in the format `[user_id:team_id]`.

markdown.description:
The content in markdown.
Any user mention tags are shown in the format `[user_id:team_id]`

CommentObject.description: Identifying information about the object (such as a design) that the comment is attached to.

mentions.description: The Canva users mentioned in the comment thread or reply.

DeleteSuggestedEdit.description: A suggestion to delete some text.

DesignCommentObject.description: If the comment is attached to a Canva Design.

design_id.description: The ID of the design this comment is attached to.

FormatSuggestedEdit.description: A suggestion to format some text.

ParentComment.description:
Data about the comment, including the message, author, and
the object (such as a design) the comment is attached to.

id.description:
The ID of the comment.

You can use this ID to create replies to the comment using the [Create reply API](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/create-reply/).

message.description:
The comment message. This is the comment body shown in the Canva UI.
User mentions are shown here in the format `[user_id:team_id]`.

created_at.description:
When the comment or reply was created, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the comment or reply was last updated, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

mentions.description: The Canva users mentioned in the comment.

ReplyComment.description:
Data about the reply comment, including the message, author, and
the object (such as a design) the comment is attached to.

message.description:
The comment message. This is the comment body shown in the Canva UI.
User mentions are shown here in the format `[user_id:team_id]`.

created_at.description:
When the comment or reply was created, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the comment or reply was last updated, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

mentions.description: The Canva users mentioned in the comment.

thread_id.description:
The ID of the comment thread this reply is in. This ID is the same as the `id` of the
parent comment.

SuggestedEdit.description: The type of the suggested edit, along with additional type-specific properties.

SuggestionStatus.description: The current status of the suggestion.
x-enum-descriptions: A suggestion was made, but it hasn't been accepted or rejected yet.
A suggestion was accepted and applied to the design.
A suggestion was rejected and not applied to the design.

TeamUser.description: Metadata for the user, consisting of the User ID, Team ID, and display name.

team_id.description: The ID of the user's Canva Team.

display_name.description: The name of the user as shown in the Canva UI.

Thread.description:
A discussion thread on a design.

The `type` of the thread can be found in the `thread_type` object, along with additional type-specific properties.
The `author` of the thread might be missing if that user account no longer exists.

id.description:
The ID of the thread.

You can use this ID to create replies to the thread using the [Create reply API](https://www.canva.dev/docs/apps/rest-apis/reference/comments/create-reply/).

design_id.description: The ID of the design that the discussion thread is on.

created_at.description:
When the thread was created, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

updated_at.description:
When the thread was last updated, as a Unix timestamp
(in seconds since the Unix Epoch).

ThreadType.description: The type of the discussion thread, along with additional type-specific properties.

User.description: Metadata for the user, consisting of the User ID and display name.

display_name.description: The name of the user as shown in the Canva UI.

UserMention.description: Information about the user mentioned in a comment thread or reply. Each user mention is keyed using the user's user ID and team ID separated by a colon (`user_id:team_id`).

tag.description: The mention tag for the user mentioned in the comment thread or reply content. This has the format of the user's user ID and team ID separated by a colon (`user_id:team_id`).
